name: io.github.allooloo/getauditor
title: Allooloo Auditor
description: The auditor of an issuer and every change on the record, dated: signed and receipted (RCO-10060).

tools.name: get_auditor
tools.description: get_auditor is the auditor of an issuer: an issuer by ticker, ISIN or LEI returns its auditor of record and every auditor change on the record, dated — each with its source page and read date, signed by the node of the issuer's market and receipted. Where a market's record does not carry the auditor, the answer says not_on_record for that market; nothing is inferred. Typed errors: unknown_issuer, ambiguous, not_on_record (per field, per market), invalid_request. Door: https://mcp.getauditor.ai/mcp (routes to the owning node); every node door answers it for its own market.

issuer.description: Ticker (with exchange where it helps: NASDAQ:AAPL, SHEL.L), ISIN or LEI.

tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI. The router names the issuer's home market and forwards to that market's MCP for the record summary.

identifier.description: Ticker with or without exchange (SHOP, TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L, BHP.AX, D05.SI, NESN.SW, SAP.DE, 7203.T, 005930.KS), ISIN, LEI, an exact legal name or a sourced alias.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Every market on the roster (nodes.json, with its region), which are live, and each market's MCP and agent card.
